info.name: Notes API — Task 7
info.description: Full-featured Notes API: pagination, filtering, and consistent error handling. Base URL: http://localhost:3000/v1

request.description: Creates a new note. `text` is required and must be non-empty; `completed` is optional and defaults to false.

response.name: 200 OK
